concepts.name: Acceleration
concepts.simple_definition: Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity with time.
concepts.deep_explanation: Average acceleration is a_avg = (v - u) / t, where v is final velocity and u is initial velocity. It is measured in m/s².
concepts.real_example: A rocket accelerating from rest to 100 m/s in 10 seconds has an acceleration of 10 m/s².
concepts.common_confusion: Assuming negative acceleration always means slowing down. It can mean speeding up in the negative direction.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: ማጣደፍ ማለት የፍጥነት ለውጥ በጊዜ ሂደት ያለውን ፍጥነት የሚለካበት የፊዚክስ መጠን ነው።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: አማካይ ማጣደፍ a = (v - u) / t ሲሆን፣ v የመጨረሻ ፍጥነት u ደግሞ መጀመሪያ ፍጥነት ነው። ክፍሉ ሜ/ሰ² ነው።
concepts.real_example_amharic: አንድ ሮኬት ከእረፍት ተነስቶ በ 10 ሰከንድ ውስጥ 100 ሜ/ሰ ፍጥነት ላይ ሲደርስ ማጣደፉ 10 ሜ/ሰ² ይሆናል።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: አሉታዊ ማጣደፍ ሁልጊዜ ፍጥነት መቀነስን ብቻ ያሳያል ብሎ ማሰብ።

concepts.name: 22 Unit 2 Uniformly Accelerated Motion 2
concepts.simple_definition: 22 Unit 2 Uniformly Accelerated Motion 2.1 Position and Displacement By the end of this section, you should be able to: • deﬁne terms such as position, displacement, and distance; • determine the distance and displacement traveled by an object; • describe the difference between distance and displacement
concepts.deep_explanation: Exercise 2.1 Can two objects be at the same distance from a single point while being in different positions? Why or why not? Key Concept  The location of an object in a frame of reference is called position

concepts.name: 24 Unit 2 Uniformly Accelerated Motion F
concepts.simple_definition: 24 Unit 2 Uniformly Accelerated Motion For motion of the object from O to A, the distance covered is 60 km and the magnitude of displacement is also 60 km
concepts.deep_explanation: During its motion from O to A and back to B, the distance covered = 60 km + 25 km = 85 km while the magnitude of displacement = 60 km - 25 km = 35 km
